BLUE RIDGE PEDIATRIC ASSOCIATES - PROGRESS NOTE (SOAP) Patient: Holloway, River Anders DOB: 03/03/2089 Age: 3 y 7 m MRN: 5530-1127 Sex: M Date of service: 10/03/2092 Provider: Amara Nwosu-Bell, MD Visit type: Sick visit Accompanied by: father, Desmond Holloway
CHIEF COMPLAINT: Ear pain, left.
SUBJECTIVE: River is a 3-year-old boy with egg allergy, childhood asthma and prior ear infections who presents with 2 days of left otalgia and fever to 101.8 that began Thursday. Father says he had a temp this morning too. Slept poorly. Drinking fine, fewer solids. Attends Little Acorns Preschool 3 days a week. Sibling Sage (7, Hollow Creek Elementary, second grade) had a cold last week. No smoke exposure.
Social history (copied forward from 02/08/2092): Lives with mother Tamsin (teaching assistant, Greenbough Montessori), father Desmond (HVAC technician, Altamont HVAC) and brother Sage. Maternal grandmother Ruth Ellery helps with pickup, lives two streets over. Landlord: Bartholomew Quist. Neighbour: Ignatius Pell. Pets: dog named Holloway (father's joke - "dog has the family name"). Social history (today): father reports heat at home out for 2 weeks, they have been using space heaters. Mom now working Mondays through Thursdays.
Medications: cetirizine 5 mg daily, epinephrine auto-injector 0.3 mL as needed, [fluticasone and albuterol - stopped 02/08/2092 per list, still carried forward in this note]. Allergies: egg.
OBJECTIVE: T 38.2 oral, HR 118, RR 24, SpO2 98%, wt 15.8 kg. Fussy but consolable. Left TM bulging, erythematous, loss of landmarks, no perforation. Right TM clear. Throat mildly red. Neck supple. Lungs clear, no wheeze. Heart regular. Skin: no rash.
ASSESSMENT/PLAN: 1. Acute otitis media, left. High-dose amoxicillin x 10 days. Pharmacy: Cedar Fork Pharmacy, fax (828) 555-0120. Ibuprofen for pain. 2. Egg allergy - continue avoidance; epinephrine pen up to date; school form for Ms. Farrant signed. 3. Childhood asthma - stable. 4. Recurrent otitis - 4th episode; if another within 6 months refer ENT. 5. Follow up 10/17/2092 recheck ears. Parent given Dr. Nwosu-Bell's card.
